commits.message:
BUG/parser: Parsing after a syntax error fixed

'END' token was not inserted after an error and the parser
attempted to _continue_ the error.

BUG: grammar.y: Bug fixed in the parser

In some case, we can speak about a line that is not defined.
This could lead to a segfault.

lexer.re: We could set error but not remove them.

It is fixed now. We also added some code to empty the stack after
an error.

FEATURE: plane: hasExpr is improved and almost works

This new feature works on unit tests. I'm not sure there are no
memory leak or dead locks for now.
FEATURE: boolTable: Karnaugh table is computed from boolean expressions

FEATURE: tests: New tests on BoolExpr

Beginning of new features on BoolExpr also.

At the moment, I work on Karnaugh table generations. It is not finished,
but clearly in progress.
CLEANUP: dr-pythagore: Almost comments added
CLEANUP: dr-pythagore: Tests are back and OK

FEATURE: BoolExpr: New class to represent boolean expressions

The notion of relation is to short to describe the geometrical
situations.
This is a reworking, there are some dead code by here and by there,
but it is work in progress.
FEATURE: taskrule: Evolution of this class

FEATURE: taskrule: Big reorganization

The tasklua was a bad idea. Instead, we have a lua_State for each
action. This lua_State has access to the Plane. That way, we can have
tasks that are just lua functions which should simplify the code a lot.
CLEANUP: lexer.re: Debug removed

FEATURE: tasklua: We have a first step in the lua integration

It needs many improvement, but we have a little access to the plane
from Lua scripts.

FEATURE: grammar.y: New syntax to define points

We can define several points at a time: Let A,B,C:Point
FEATURE: tasklua: A first not operational task to allow Lua scripts

FEATURE: DPTaskLua: New class to execute inline lua scripts

This is just a draft to make tests.

REORG: Plane/OpRel: Old bad names renamed

DPPlan becomes DPPlane
DPBinRel becomes DPOpRel because operators are not only binary.

FEATURE: rule.cpp: New class

The tuple is replaced by a home made class.
CLEANUP: dptree: not used

FEATURE: checkequaldistinct: A first task to check contradictions

We have a first version of this task and a test OK with it.

BUG: pool: Bug fixed in rules and plans. Tests added.

We could have several rules giving the same informations.
Functions in the pool were not used.
A function in task becomes abstract.

Tests are added to check tasks. The test is not finished because of
contradiction that must be specified to be repaired later.

FEATURE: plan: Contradiction return reasons.

When a contradiction (executed by a task) is revealed, a reason is given
detailing what is the contradiction.

FEATURE: dptree: It works with integers.

This tree needs many improvments but gives good results for now.

FEATURE: dptree: Improvment of the dptree

The test suite has a first test that works on it.
The only supported key is integers.

FEATURE: dptree: New radix tree implementation

It can work with a bench of keys. The user has just a comparaison
function to implement for that.

At the moment, it is not operational.

FEATURE: cppunit: Test suite working.

It works with cppunit.

FEATURE:segment: Distinctness between two segments is implemented.

Also, when an empty line is entered, the program does not quit.
CLEANUP: parser: unused file removed.

FEATURE: readline: drpythagore has a little readline engine

It is really minimalistic but we can test it now.

FEATURE: tasks: A first task is in test

It checks if there exists elements declared as distinct and in the same
time equal. In that case, the software is aborted for now waiting for a
better solution...

FEATURE: tasks: First task prototype

This task will check if two objects are not assumed to be equal and
in the same time distinct.

Needs to be implemented.
FEATURE: pool/element: plan and pool are linked.
FEATURE: pool: getters/setters improvment.

REORG: elements: dp... files renamed without dp

dpelement.cpp becomes element.cpp

REORG: parser: dp... files renamed without dp

dpparser.cpp becomes parser.cpp

FEATURE: pool: Implementation of a first threads pool version.

It is not totally operational but begins to work.
TESTS: tests: First tests are functional.
FEATURE: parser: Notion of set better managed.
FEATURE: segment: We have a segment now.

BUG: line: A case where the line must be built if it does not exist

This case was forgotten.
BUG: parser: error is taken in charge if something goes wrong.

FEATURE: lines: Comparaison between lines

We should be able to tell if two lines are equal.

It does not work for now, but we are not so far of the result.

FEATURE: line: A little work on lines

Now we can check if a point is in a line.

The check is not finished. If we assume A is in (BC).
The software should see also that B is in (AC).

Next time...

FEATURE: parser: New symbols to manage new datas

Check of equality uses an interrogation point.
To ask if A and B are equal, we enter "A = B ?".
If something implies it to be true, the answer will be 1, otherwise
it will be 0.

FEATURE: parser: Files automatically generated removed

They are no more present in the repository.
FEATURE: dr-pythagore: First commit. The parser works almost.
Initial commit
CLEANUP: tabular: not needed includes removed
feat(deps): just a little utilto check includes dependencies
BUG: module.c: A potential memory leak is fixed
BUG: GetArray: crash fixed

FEATURE: filter: New tabular.filter function

It is almost like the get function but does not support the sort
and works without the window range.
BUG: filter.c: the IN function could crash if items were not defined
FIX: count: Optimization in the count function to use RedisModuleStrings
DOC: README.md: Doc completed with tabular.count functionality

FIX: tabular: ParseArgv function is more generic

The function is able to parse fields among a given choice specified
by flags.
Also, the ParseArgv function is moved into tabular.c
FEATURE: count: New tabular.count function
CLEANUP: sort: Sort code refactored.

feature: filter.c: New filter

Now, it is possible to filter rows that contain a field in a set.

FEATURE: filter.c: New filter and code refactorized

There are now two filters available:
* WILDCARD matching
* strict strings equality
FEATURE: module.c: Accesses to hashsets improved
BUG: module.c: When STORE is used, the total size was badly returned
DOC: README.md: Documentation updated.

feature: module.c: The full size of the array is returned as well

We need to know the array size not taking in count the window range.
BUG: module.c: Memory leak fixed
CLEANUP: module.c: Coding style fixed
BUG: module.c: Bugs fixed while adding tests to incr the code coverage
TEST: code coverage: New code coverage feature on unit tests
DOC: README.md: Doc updated.

BUG: module.c: Many bugs fixed

The syntax is also updated.

FEATURE: module.c: Filter is almost implemented

The redis function is renamed into tabular.get
To sort, their is a key word SORT and to filter, their is a keyword
FILTER.
FIX:tests: the comparaison function contained a bug.

FIX: module.c: There was a double free corruption and a typo

The typo has a big impact on sort on small windows.
FEATURE: test: New tests added
BUG: hash sort: The numerical values could be badly sorted.

FEATURE: reverse sort: Num and alpha sorts can be reversed

For a field, wa can specify ALPHA, NUM, REVALPHA or REVNUM
FEATURE: redisTabular: First incomplete version
Initial commit
enh(convert): The output file name is built from the input file name.
enh(init): First version of this script.
Initial commit
